about_the_game: This album encompasses the 6 non-puzzle original tracks composed by Gisula for the game. These tracks can be heard in the rodent editor, main page, credits, trailers and more. By purchasing this album, you will receive .wav versions of these tracks, filled with plucky synths, quirky and inquisitive jazzy piano, and a fun lofi bonus track. Please note these tracks are not royalty-free.
